company_name: Saga University, Diamond Semiconductor Research Center, Kasu Lab.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Saga University is conducting advanced research on diamond semiconductor devices, which are critical for high-power applications.
summary: Saga University's Diamond Semiconductor Research Center is focused on developing diamond semiconductor devices that offer superior performance compared to traditional materials like GaN. They have achieved significant milestones in crystal growth and doping technology, enabling the fabrication of high-voltage, low-resistance power devices.
capabilities: Fabrication of diamond power semiconductor devices
